insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (depends on Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table)

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: Once in the Policy Year, We shall provide for a reload of the Sum Insured ... in case the available Sum Insured which shall be considered to be inclusive of accumulated No Claim Bonus (if any), is insufficient for covering a claim under the Policy as a result of previous claims in that Policy Year.
great.reference: Section C.I (h) Reload of Sum Insured
great.explanation: You get a one-time reload of the Sum Insured within the policy year if your available limit (including No Claim Bonus) is insufficient for a new claim. This provides extra coverage after exhausting your base limit, helping with multiple claims in the same year.

great.name: Initial Waiting
great.quote: Waiting periods do not apply in respect of this Benefit.
great.explanation: Waiting periods are waived for the OPD benefit, allowing immediate use of outpatient services subject to sub-limits. This means you can claim OPD expenses right from the start of the policy.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with Insurer.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 24 months of continuous coverage, which is standard in the market. This means you must wait two years before claiming for pre-existing conditions.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with us.
good.reference: Section D.I.2 Specified disease / procedure waiting period (Code-Excl02)
good.explanation: Coverage for listed specific diseases and procedures begins after 24 months of continuous coverage, which is typical. This means you need to wait two years before claiming for these conditions.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the ﬁrst policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: A standard 30-day waiting period applies for illnesses, but accidents are covered immediately. This means you cannot claim for illnesses within the first month except for accidents.

good.name: Restore Benefit
good.quote: The reload of Sum Insured shall be available only for subsequent claims and not in relation to any Illness/ Injury (including its complications) for which a claim has been admitted for the Insured Person during that Policy Year.
good.reference: Section C.I (h) Reload of Sum Insured - Condition (iii)
good.explanation: The reload benefit applies only to new illnesses or injuries, not for repeat claims on the same condition within the policy year. This means you get extra cover for different illnesses but not for the same one again.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: We shall cover the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization, up to the limits as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
good.explanation: Home-based treatment when hospitalization is required is covered subject to policy limits and conditions. This means you can claim for treatment at home if hospitalization is not possible.

good.name: Air Ambulance (Domestic)
good.quote: Domestic Emergency Assistance Services (including Air Ambulance)
good.explanation: Emergency evacuation including air ambulance is available within India under specified conditions. This means you can get air ambulance services for emergencies inside the country.

good.name: Air Ambulance (International)
good.quote: International Emergency Assistance Services (including Air Ambulance)
good.explanation: Emergency evacuation and repatriation services are available for trips outside India up to 90 days, subject to conditions. This means you have air ambulance cover during short international travel.

good.name: No Claim Bonus
good.quote: The accumulated No Claim Bonus shall not exceed 50% of the Sum Insured ... In the event of a claim impacting the eligibility of a No Claim Bonus, the accumulated No Claim Bonus shall be reduced by 10% of the Sum Insured at the commencement of subsequent Policy Year.
good.explanation: No Claim Bonus can accumulate up to 50% of the Sum Insured but reduces by 10% after a claim instead of resetting to zero. This means you retain some bonus even after making a claim.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: If this option is chosen ... discount of 10% on the premium... If the Insured Person takes Inpatient hospitalization ... in a Hospital other than those listed as “Preferred Provider Network”, then the Policyholder / Insured Person shall bear a Co-Payment of 15% on each and every claim
bad.explanation: You can opt for a 10% premium discount but must pay 15% co-pay if treated outside the preferred network. This means you save premium but accept higher co-payments for non-network hospitals.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: Reasonable and Customary Charges for Room Rent ... up to the limits as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy;
bad.reference: Section C.I (a) In-patient Hospitalization - What is covered (1)
bad.explanation: Room rent is capped as per the policy schedule rather than being unlimited or at actuals. This can reduce claim amounts if your room rent exceeds the limit.

bad.name: Proportionate Deduction
bad.quote: If the Insured Person is admitted in a room category/limit that is higher than the one that is speciﬁed ... then the Insured Person shall bear a rateable proportion of the total Associated Medical Expenses
bad.explanation: If you choose a room category above your entitlement, the insurer will reduce your claim proportionally on related medical expenses. This can significantly increase your out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Activ Care Policy Wordings - Annexure - I - List of Non-medical expenses ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 62 OXYGEN MASK ... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED
bad.reference: Annexure I – List of Non-medical expenses
bad.explanation: Many common hospital consumables like gloves and masks are excluded from coverage, often leading to out-of-pocket expenses. This means you may have to pay for essential items during hospitalization.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: Sublimit for listed illnesses: We will cover the Medical Expenses arising out of an Insured Person’s in-patient Hospitalization for the listed Illness/ conditions and limit as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table.
bad.reference: Section C.I (j) Sublimit for listed illnesses
bad.explanation: The policy imposes sub-limits on specific diseases as per the schedule, which can reduce your claim payout for common illnesses. This limits the financial protection for those conditions.

bad.name: Domiciliary Exclusions
bad.quote: We shall not be liable to pay for any claim made under this Beneﬁt in connection with: (1) Asthma... (5) Diabetes mellitus and insipidus; ... (7) Hypertension; ...
bad.reference: Section C.I (e) Domiciliary Hospitalization - What is not covered
bad.explanation: Several common chronic conditions like asthma, diabetes, and hypertension are excluded from domiciliary hospitalization cover. This limits the usefulness of home treatment for these illnesses.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: if the Age ... is 61 years or above... shall bear a Co-payment per claim ... as speciﬁed in Product Beneﬁt Table/Policy Schedule.
bad.explanation: A mandatory co-pay applies for insured persons aged 61 and above, but the exact percentage is not stated here. Check your policy schedule for the co-pay amount.

unclear.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
unclear.quote: We shall cover ... the Insured Person’s Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred ... in accordance with the limits speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
unclear.explanation: The number of pre-hospitalization days covered is not stated here and depends on the policy schedule. You should check your specific plan for exact pre-hospitalization coverage.

unclear.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
unclear.quote: We shall cover ... the Insured Person’s Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses ... in accordance with the limits speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
unclear.explanation: The number of post-hospitalization days covered is not specified here and depends on the policy schedule. Verify your plan details to know the exact post-hospitalization coverage.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: Cashless Facilities can be availed only at Our Network Providers/ Empanelled Service Providers. The complete list of Network Providers and Empaneled Service Providers is available on Our website
unclear.explanation: The policy does not specify the number of network hospitals available for cashless claims. Confirm network size and key hospitals from the insurer’s website.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
